messages:
Lina (Partnerships): Heads-up: small experiment to validate LangChain + our gateway adapter on a partner rack. Want a reproducible minimal demo for marketplace listing and SI handoff. Who can scope a 1-page runbook?

Bea (DevEx): I can do the runbook. plan: 1) adapter install snippet, 2) quickstart notebook, 3) sanity tests. will include node/python examples.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Need to decide the routing behavior for the demo: prefer simple policy 'prefer-dedicated-then-fallback' and expose it as a config sample. I'll post a JSON example: `{"policy":"prefer-dedicated","fallback":"cpu-small"}`.

Ravi (SI Lead): For SI handoff, include an onboarding checklist: creds, SSO details, sample corpus, smoke prompts, and escalation contact. can you also add a short troubleshooting section for model mismatch?

Hannah (HW Partnerships): On the hardware side: we'll provide a baseline node image and a small perf spec: p95 < 350ms for 512 tokens @ 6 streams on g1-4. will upload image link to the runbook.

Lina (Partnerships): Great. Timeline: runbook draft by Tue EOD, demo notebook + adapter PR by Thu, perf logs by Fri. Bea/Omar/Ravi/Hannah please update here as you complete items. :white_check_mark:
